_comment: A FIXTURE, not a loot table. Deliberately NOT under data/recompile/loot_table/, so the game
never loads it and no player can ever roll it - SortingData reads raw classpath paths, so a
test can point at it without it becoming content.
It exists because tag expansion lost all of its coverage the day wool left the bag stream.
Wool and wool carpets were the only two tag entries the mod shipped; with both gone, ZERO loot
tables use one, SortingData.expandTag has an unreachable call site, and the test named
sorting_data_expands_a_tag_entry passed while expanding nothing. Coverage that depends on a
piece of content still existing disappears silently when the content is retuned, which is the
same shape as a pull hook that only covered hand sorting.
Shape mirrors a real pull pool: one tag entry with expand:false (roll once, then pick a member,
so the share splits evenly across the tag) alongside plain item entries, weights summing to 100.
